answer_1.quote: We investigate four conditional text generation tasks, ranging from more precision-oriented tasks like machine translation to more open-ended tasks like commonsense generation and question generation.
answer_1.outputs: generated questions, commonsense sentences, summaries, and translations

answer_2.quote: We measure the generated outputs from multiple aspects including text quality, relevance, diversity...

answer_3.quote: We adopt a state-of-the-art quality estimation model for MT, COMET-QE. The quality estimation model we use to rerank all the outputs is wmt21-comet-qe-da.
